from pathlib import Path
import sys,hashlib
import pytest,sysconfig
purelib=Path(sysconfig.get_path('purelib')).resolve()
pytest_code=Path(pytest.skip.__code__.co_filename).resolve()
print('dependency_binding',pytest.__version__,pytest_code,'sandbox_purelib',purelib)
assert pytest_code.is_relative_to(purelib),(pytest_code,purelib)
import monkeytype.stubs as module
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
assert actual==(Path.cwd()/'monkeytype/stubs.py').resolve(),actual
print('source_binding',actual,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'Python',sys.version)
from inspect import Signature,Parameter
from typing import Optional,get_type_hints
from monkeytype.stubs import FunctionStub,FunctionKind,ImportBlockStub,ModuleStub,get_imports_for_signature
sig=Signature([Parameter('value',Parameter.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD,default=None,annotation=int)],return_annotation=int)
imports=get_imports_for_signature(sig)
text=ModuleStub(function_stubs=[FunctionStub('read_value',sig,FunctionKind.MODULE)],imports_stub=ImportBlockStub(imports)).render()
print('generated_stub',text)
namespace={}
exec(compile(text,'<generated-stub>','exec'),namespace)
annotations=get_type_hints(namespace['read_value'])
print('resolved_annotations',annotations)
assert annotations['value']==Optional[int],annotations
assert annotations['return'] is int
PYREPLAY
